limits: WebFetch and WebSearch return model-extracted text (verbatim with markdown removed). Quotes were not byte-compared with live pages; long sentences are trimmed and marked.
CARTO live status, body and CORS are unverified: the egress proxy returned 502 to CONNECT and the fetch was not retried. The key requirement rests on vendor docs.
A USGS FAQ URL I first guessed (what-are-terms-uselicense-map-services...) returned 404; the live slug is 'what-are-terms-uselicensing-map-services-and-data-national-map', found by search.
MapKit JS reference pages rendered titles only. Membership prerequisite, 3D or globe support and non-browser restrictions are not stated on pages reached.
Protomaps: only the 127-byte header and the directory entry count were read; no planet tile was fetched or decoded.
GIBS 15m layers were sampled at zooms 5, 8 and 9 and 4 locations; no populated 15m label tile was found. The placeholder reading comes from bytes, not GIBS documentation.

Visual reads are qualitative (names and lines as seen, not OCR). Overlay statistics are PIL luma of per-channel absolute difference. OpenFreeMap decoding used a minimal MVT reader written for this check. Cesium tutorial uses CesiumJS 1.145; the MVTDataProvider source link shows 1.146.

Not checked: MapLibre globe projection and other globe libraries (W7 scope), Cesium ion requirements, GIBS layer legends. Downloads, crops and result JSON sit in the session scratchpad under globe-dl/labels-on-globe/ (not in the repo); scripts under globe-scripts/labels-on-globe/.
open_questions: Is the 921-byte opaque-black PNG GIBS's no-data marker for every 15m layer and zoom? Sample zooms 6-13 across regions. Until then filter by MD5 or drop 15m layers.
Do current USGS ImageryTopo road and label pixels carry the commercially licensed US Topo road data described for 2010-2016 maps? Carson's use is commercial; confirm per layer before shipping.
CARTO: fetch basemap.cartocdn.com/light_only_labels with a key, or via an allowed route, to confirm status, body and CORS.
MapKit JS: is an Apple Developer Program membership required, is 3D or globe offered, and may MapKit JS run in a WebView or desktop container?
OpenFreeMap: terms give no licence for map data and no attribution wording beyond the TileJSON string. Confirm whether bundled offline use is allowed beyond the per-download limits.

Protomaps: the planet file is 138.9 GB, so any use needs a regional pmtiles extract. Check licence and CORS for the extract, and the truncated 'Real Time Navigation' clause. Cesium MVTDataProvider is experimental; a pre-rendered raster label layer is the stable alternative (inference, untested).
